note: STISS features include preaxial hand abnormalities and variable craniofacial dysmorphisms, while hallmark features of CdLS (severe limb reduction, dense hypertrichosis) and RSTS (broad angulated thumbs) are not typical STISS features.

evidence.text: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome is characterized by developmental delay/intellectual disability, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, subtle facial features, and preaxial hand abnormalities.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: In addition to previously reported DD/ID, speech delay, cardiac and renal anomalies, we also confirmed preaxial hand abnormalities as a feature of this syndrome.

evidence.text: Patients with STISS show developmental delay, intellectual disability, craniofacial, and skeletal anomalies including ectopic fingernail, but lack classic CdLS or RSTS severe dysmorphic hallmarks.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating  PSMD12  Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: Portraying a completely penetrant condition with inter- and intra-familiar clinical variability, all individuals presented with developmental delay, intellectual disability, craniofacial, and skeletal anomalies.
